name: Hindu Push-Up
instructions: Start in a pike position: hands and feet on the floor a little wider than shoulder width, hips high and arms straight.
Bend your elbows and lower your head and chest toward the floor between your hands.
Swoop your chest forward close to the floor, then straighten your arms and push your chest up and forward. Let your hips sink toward the floor and look up.
Push your hips back up and straighten your arms to return to the pike position.
Move smoothly from one repetition to the next.
